stem: What is a major way Jason Taylor's sculptures in the selection “Dive into a Sunken Museum” DIFFER from Forrest Fenn’s treasure in the selection “A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt”?
instruction: Use “Dive into a Sunken Museum” and “A Modern-Day Treasure Hunt” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text:
Taylor wants his sculptures to be protected from outdoor conditions.

Fenn wants his treasure to be exposed to outdoor conditions.

options.label: B
options.text:
Taylor wants people to know where to find his sculptures.

Fenn wants to keep the location of his treasure hidden.

options.label: C
options.text:
Taylor wants people to interact with his sculptures.

Fenn wants people to stay away from his treasure.

options.label: D
options.text:
Taylor wants his sculptures to be viewed in a traditional way.

Fenn wants his treasure to be seen in a nontraditional way.
